==Walkthrough==
===Tracking Islwyn===
[[File:Isafdar map.png|thumb|350x350px]]
{{Needed|recommended=teleport to Ardougne and either: [[ring of charos(a)]] & 1600gp '''''or''''' 3200gp for each trip.}}
{{Checklist|*Head to [[Tirannwn]] (''[[Catherby teleport (tablet)]], use charter to Port Tyras'')
*Track down [[Islwyn]], who will be either west of [[Lletya]] or north-east of the [[Tyras Camp]]. Use [[:File:Isafdar map.png|this map]] to assist you. (If the elves are not there, switch worlds until they appear)
*Offer your help to Islwyn. {{Chat option|1Tell the truth?|1Maybe I could help.}}
*Talk to [[Eluned]].}}
===Obtaining the Seed===
{{Needed|[[Glarial's pebble]]|recommended=[[skills necklace]], food, [[prayer potion]]s, [[ring of recoil]]}}
{{Checklist|*Bank all your combat equipment, runes included.
**Go to [[Tree Gnome Village dungeon]] and retrieve Glarial's pebble if you didn't save one from Waterfall Quest.
*Travel north-west of the [[Fishing Guild]] and use [[Glarial's pebble]] on [[Glarial's tombstone]].
*Kill a [[Moss Guardian]] (''level 84''). It will drop a [[consecration seed]].
*Take the seed to Eluned.}}

===Planting The Seed===
{{Needed|rope, spade, consecration seed|recommended=[[games necklace]] (to [[Barbarian Outpost]]), Ardougne teleport.}}
{{Checklist|*Enter the [[Waterfall Dungeon]].
**Board the log raft north of [[Baxtorian Falls]].
**Use a rope on the rock.
**Use a rope on the dead tree.
**Open the door to enter.
*''(Skip this step if you already have the [[A key (Waterfall Dungeon)|key]].)'' Search the most northern crates in the east room for a key.
*Take the west path all the way north.
*Left click the seed in the final room to plant it.
*Return to [[Islwyn]] to choose your reward.
*'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''
**Optional: Speak to Eluned to start Mourning's End Part I, which will allow you to receive the teleport crystal to Lletya.}}
